trap.label: despite of
trap.wrong: Despite of repeated promises, talks failed.
trap.why: Em português “apesar de” leva preposição, e o aluno cria despite of. Em inglês, despite não leva of; in spite of é a forma com of.

opts: In spite of the strike threat

mcq.q: “___ talks lasted a year, there was no deal.”

fix.wrong: Despite the talks lasted a year, there was no deal.
fix.right: Although the talks lasted a year, there was no deal.

fix.wrong: In spite the strike threat, the mayor stayed calm.
fix.right: In spite of the strike threat, the mayor stayed calm.

fix.wrong: Although of the delay, they signed.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com despite: “Although the union threatened a strike, talks went on.”
rewrite.answer: Despite the strike threat, talks went on.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Although: “Despite the mayor’s patience, talks failed.”
rewrite.answer: Although the mayor was patient, talks failed.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com in spite of: “Despite the pay rise, they left.”
rewrite.answer: In spite of the pay rise, they left.
